# The 10-Step Methodology

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## The 10-Step Methodology

Here is the exact sequence I used to ship SpeedBlip. This is not theoretical - every step happened in order, and the order mattered.

- Step 1 - Define the product: What it does, who it is for, core features
- Step 2 - Name and brand: Tool name, tagline, audience feel
- Step 3 - Brand guidelines: Colors, typography, UI style, spacing, motion, voice - locked before any design
- Step 4 - Design pipeline decision: Chose Framer AI for wireframes, skipped Stitch and Figma
- Step 5 - Responsive design planning: Breakpoints, navigation patterns per screen size
- Step 6 - Prompt architecture: Broke the entire build into 7 focused chunks, each ending with a git commit
- Step 7 - Pre-build setup: GitHub repo, Netlify connected, Claude Code installed, repo cloned
- Step 8 - Build execution: The 7 chunks, executed in sequence
- Step 9 - Final fixes: Navigation linking, chart bugs, sidebar flicker, button debugging
- Step 10 - Ship and share: LinkedIn post, first-comment link, engagement strategy

Every chapter of this course maps to one or more of these steps. By the end, you will have followed the full arc from zero to shipped.
